rounds.report:
CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline, representation level L1 (proxy).

Observed (24 reference samples, 0-8.48 s): a first-person shooter view walking through tall olive rock-canyon corridors with a bluish floor, a dark-blue rifle held at lower right. The player turns left at a corner (~0.7-1.8 s), a dark-suited guard runs into the corridor (~1.5-1.9 s), approaches while the player fires (muzzle flash, sparks ~2.2-2.9 s), drops his gun (~2.95 s), clutches his head (~3.3 s), takes a head shot with a smoke puff (~3.7 s) and falls (~4.05 s). The player turns right into a narrow canyon with a sunlit tan end wall and sky (~4.4-5.2 s), turns right again (~5.5-6.2 s), walks down a corridor with a ledge step down (~6.3-7.4 s), and approaches a pale-blue doorway with red stairs and a second guard at the top (~7.4-8.48 s).

Geometry: corridors built from axis-aligned boxes (walls 14 m tall, sunlit tan bands on two far walls), floors with a raised light slab at the first corner and a 0.8 m ledge in the last corridor; pale-blue building hall with six red stair boxes and a landing. Unlit per-face shaded materials plus linear fog.
Articulation: two guard proxies with hips, spine, head, shoulders, elbows, hips and knees; guard 1 runs, walks while aiming, reels, drops his gun (separate analytic projectile), clutches his head and falls by an axis-angle tilt about the feet. Guard 2 stands with a raised arm. Muzzle flash, spark and smoke proxies are timed deterministically.
Camera: single continuous first-person shot (no cuts), 60 deg vertical FOV, Hermite-interpolated keyframes at every sample time (position, yaw, pitch) with small head bob; the weapon is parented to the camera.
Inference: world layout, distances, the guard's route between samples and the exact turn timings are inferred from the sampled frames; the frames between samples are analytic interpolation.
Feedback: none received yet (initial round).
